description: Start a durable child agent with exactly one origin: a named profile for a fresh child, or fork=true for completed parent context. Inspect or continue an associated child by agent_id; continue sends a new task only after its prior turn has settled. Set background=true on start or continue to return after process start, without waiting for the answer. Inspection reports only durable transcript evidence and may leave completion uncertain. Active means a parent admission slot, not verified process liveness. Add this tool to a profile's tools list to opt in.
